fig.title: Sample of the Vibration X FFT absolute value waveform

conbody.p: Figure 20 is a waveform graph showing Fast Fourier Transform absolute value in metres per second squared (m/s2) data from the X-axis sensor.

ul.li: The graph’s X-axis shows frequency in Hertz.
The graph’s Y-Axis shows the absolute value of the FFT of the X-Axis accelerometer signal in metres per second squared (m/s2).
